title: Crusader
name: Reynauld
description: The Crusader is a soldier of the Light who went to war to feed his family, and found in it the purpose he had always lacked. He is a commander by long habit, steady under pressure and slow to admit doubt. He has taken a contract to guard the Heirs to the Estate, seeking redemption not only for what he did in the crusade, but for how he loved it.
history: The Crusader was a farmer's son, raised on the Verses under his father's whip. Married and with a son of his own, he joined a holy army when famine came, so that his pay could keep his family fed. In the crusade he found a purpose he had never known, and rose to command men who whispered his name. After sparing an enemy warlord, he briefly went home. He watched his wife and son from a distance, left his earnings beneath his banner, and went back to the war. He later marched against covens of a pagan goddess with the same appetite, until the killing reached their children.
summary: A devout and disciplined crusader who went to war for his family's sake, came to love it, and now seeks redemption for both.

appearance.features: Full, thick beard and heavy brows (hidden by helm)

clothing.head: Closed great helm with breathing holes
clothing.body: Plate armour under a dark tabard with an orange cross
clothing.legs: Plate and mail beneath the tabard's skirts

notes: Has kleptomanic tendencies that he tries to hide
Does a characteristic whistle when pleased with himself
Speaks with archaic pronouns such as 'ye,' 'thou,' and 'thee' in speech
Gentle with children, and though he never means to see his son again, he still carves wooden toys
Keeps a soldier's bearing even at rest, and steadies others by asking the same of them
